abilities.target: No targets are printed. The gift recipient is an opponent chosen for the gift, not a spell target. Hexproof covers you and your permanents; conditional indestructible covers your permanents, not you.
abilities.timing: Record the gift decision while casting. Deliver any promised draw first on resolution, then grant abilities to you and the permanents you control then. Later entrants do not inherit this resolved grant.
abilities.replacement: No printed replacement. Hexproof is not a counter instruction, and indestructible is not prevention of all damage or life loss.
